{{short description|German mathematician (born 1963)}}
'''Harald Garcke'''  (born June 5, 1963 in [[Bremerhaven]])<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uni-regensburg.de/Fakultaeten/nat_Fak_I/Mat8/lst/ |title=Lehrstuhl Garcke |publisher=Uni-regensburg.de |date= |access-date=2015-10-23}}</ref> is a German mathematician and professor at the [[University of Regensburg]].

== Career and important results ==
Garcke studied Mathematics and Computer Science at the [[University of Bonn]] and finished his PhD 1993 as a student of  [[Hans Wilhelm Alt]] (''Travelling-Wave-Lösungen als Realisierung von Phasenübergängen bei Gedächtnismetallen'').<ref>Travelling-Wave-Lösungen als Realisierung von Phasenübergängen bei Gedächtnismetallen., Bonner mathematische Schriften Nr. 256 Garcke, Harald: Verlag: Mathematisches Institut, Bonn,, 1993</ref> 1993/94 he was  post-doc with [[Charles M. Elliott]] at the [[University of Sussex]] and from 1994 he was scientific assistant in Bonn where he finished his habilitation in 2000 (with the habilitation thesis ''On mathematical models for phase separation in elastically stressed solids'').<ref name="Elliott">{{cite journal |doi=10.1137/S0036141094267662 |title=On the Cahn-Hilliard equation with degenerate mobility|journal=SIAM Journal on Mathematical Analysis|volume=27|issue=2|pages=404–423|year=1996|last1=Elliott|first1=Charles M.|last2=Garcke|first2=Harald}}</ref> In the year  2001 he got offers for professur-positions at the Universities Regensburg and Duisburg. Since 2002 he is full professor at the [[University of Regensburg]] where he was dean of the Mathematics department from 2005 to 2007.

Garcke works on nonlinear [[partial differential equations]], free boundary problems, phase field equations, numerical analysis and geometric evolution equations. Together with [[Christof Eck]] and [[Peter Knabner]] he is the author of a book on mathematical modelling.<ref>Christof Eck,  Harald Garcke, Peter Knabner: Mathematische Modellierung. Springer-Verlag, 2008</ref>

His most important works are fundamental results on the [[Cahn-Hilliard equation]],<ref name="Elliott"/><ref>{{Cite journal |doi = 10.1017/S0308210500002419|title = On Cahn—Hilliard systems with elasticity|journal = Proceedings of the Royal Society of Edinburgh, Section A|volume = 133|issue = 2|pages = 307–331|year = 2003|last1 = Garcke|first1 = Harald| s2cid=15383135 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |doi=10.1142/S0218202511500138|bibcode=2011arXiv1104.1336A|arxiv=1104.1336|title=Thermodynamically Consistent, Frame Indifferent Diffuse Interface Models for Incompressible Two-Phase Flows with Different Densities|journal=Mathematical Models and Methods in Applied Sciences|volume=22|issue=3|page=1150013|last1=Abels|first1=H.|last2=Garcke|first2=H.|last3=Grün|first3=G.|year=2011|s2cid=1414320 }}</ref> results on the thin film equation <ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.1137/S0036141096306170|title=On a Fourth-Order Degenerate Parabolic Equation: Global Entropy Estimates, Existence, and Qualitative Behavior of Solutions|journal=SIAM Journal on Mathematical Analysis|volume=29|issue=2|pages=321–342|year=1998|last1=Passo|first1=Roberta Dal|last2=Garcke|first2=Harald|last3=Grün|first3=Günther}}</ref> and work with [[Britta Nestler]] on phase field models.<ref>{{cite journal |doi=10.1137/S0036139998334895|title=A Multi ''Phase'' Field Concept: Numerical Simulations of Moving Phase Boundaries and Multiple Junctions|journal=SIAM Journal on Applied Mathematics|volume=60|pages=295–315|year=1999|last1=Garcke|first1=Harald|last2=Nestler|first2=Britta|last3=Stoth|first3=Barbara|url=https://publikationen.bibliothek.kit.edu/1000019281}}</ref> Work with [[J.W. Barrett]] and [[R. Nürnberg]] on the mathematics of snow crystals was also well received by the popular media.<ref>{{cite web|last=Cowen |first=Ron |url=http://www.scientificamerican.com/article/how-do-snowflakes-form/ |title=Snowflake Growth Successfully Modeled from Physical Laws |publisher=Scientific American |date=2012-03-16 |access-date=2015-10-23}}</ref>
